applications.name: Arc Overload - 1
applications.description: At the start of the fight and then every 20 seconds, the Defender gains a 25% [k=glossary/armor_up]Armor Up[/k] Buff and a Regeneration Buff, healing 25% of their Max Health. These Buffs last for 6 seconds.
